Galio

the Colossus
Mid laneSupport lane

Galio is a giant stone colossus who protects his team and crushes mages. He's sturdy against magic damage, has a taunt and a knock-up, and his ultimate lets him fly across the map to join a fight. He's simple to play and great for players who like making plays for their team.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Galio

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. He's tanky against magic damage and useful in almost every game thanks to his ultimate and crowd control.

Pick into

  • Magic damage assassins, like Akali and Katarina
  • Teams with lots of magic damage
  • Teams with divers who jump on your carries
  • Games where map plays matter, thanks to Hero's Entrance

Avoid into

  • Long-range poke mages, like Hwei and Xerath
  • Teams with mostly physical damage
  • Teams that cancel your engage with crowd control
  • Teams without follow-up damage

Great teammates

NocturneHis ultimate and your Hero's Entrance make deadly global combos.
Twisted FateHis ultimate plus yours lets two champions join any fight.
Miss FortuneYour crowd control sets up her Bullet Time.

Your team needs: Pick Galio when your team needs a frontline and engage, and has enough damage to follow up.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Hero's Entrance lets him join fights anywhere on the map and shields his allies
  • Very strong against magic damage dealers and assassins
  • Two crowd control spells (taunt and knock-up) make him a great engage champion
  • Tanky build means he's hard to kill and can lead fights

Weaknesses

  • Low damage compared to other mages, especially late
  • Long-range mages can poke him before he can engage
  • Weaker against physical damage champions
  • Needs his team to follow up on his engage

Power spikes

  • Level 3: E, W and Q unlocked. You can engage on the enemy laner when your jungler arrives.
  • Level 6: Hero's Entrance lets you help every lane. Look at the map often.
  • First item (Hextech Rocketbelt): an extra dash for engages. It was nerfed in 26.20 (less ability haste), but it's still his most common first item.
  • Two items (Imperial Mandate): your crowd control marks enemies for extra damage from your team.
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): survive after landing in the middle of the enemy team.

Top tips

  • Watch the minimap at level 6. Hero's Entrance is your best tool to help other lanes.
  • Charge W, then Flash and release for a surprise multi-person taunt.
  • Justice Punch stops on the first champion hit. Aim it at the closest target.
  • Against magic damage, you're very tanky. Trade with assassins and mages freely.
  • Your ultimate shields allies in the landing area, so it's also a defensive tool.
  • Use Teleport plus Hero's Entrance for two map plays when your wave is pushed.
